input0: Sweet Blacker... Absolutely... I love you.
Hey, Alex. I think you did a lot of work battling in that ship.
You even managed to stay strong after defeating those troopers and attacking Buckosai.
I'm surprised of how long I can still hold this chunk of the ground.
Well now that Buckosai's gone, I guess the REAL Brawl Stars Super Show will be scheduled soon.
That's all I have to say. Good job.

Kam.. BlueTheCircley is not doing well...
We defeated Buckosai from ruining our vacation... And the aliens are saved...
Oh... Also are you guys alright?
No... We are all damaged from the crash and fighting Buckosai...
Don't worry... We can come in and try to heal you guys.
Remember, I'm always here for you. Thank you.
